note.fr: Vérifiez que vous remplissez l'une des conditions d'accès : qualification d'entrée à l'université, qualification reconnue équivalente ou qualification professionnelle.
note.en: Check that you meet one of the entry requirements: university entrance qualification, an equivalent recognised qualification, or a vocational qualification.

evidence.quote: To start your degree with us, you must meet one of the following requirements: an Unrestricted university entrance qualification or an Entrance qualification for university of applied sciences a qualification recognised as equivalent or a vocational qualification

notes: The DAAD page says "Tuition fees per semester None", but this is a general institution-wide statement for a state university and not specific to this programme for non-EU students, so it is omitted. The application deadline "15 July" is for applicants from all countries and lacks a year, so it is given as a recurringDeadline. The page https://www.hochschule-rhein-waal.de/studieren/im-studium/semesterzeiten-und-fristen gives a deadline of "15.07" for first-semester Bachelor's programmes without specifying non-EU applicants, so it is not used.
